ink.$description: Ink — Primary text, primary CTA fill, nav background, heading copy — near-black with a violet undertone that ties dark elements back to the brand palette

deep-teal.$description: Deep Teal — Secondary headings, body emphasis, dark surface variation — co-leads with Ink for high-contrast typographic hierarchy

graphite.$description: Graphite — Tertiary text and dark surface variant — warm brown-black that softens the typographic scale below the primary two

fog.$description: Fog — Page canvas, section background — the warm off-white that gives the entire interface its sunlit, paper-like quality

paper.$description: Paper — Card surfaces, elevated panels, button text on dark fills — pure white reserved for content surfaces that sit above the Fog canvas

mist.$description: Mist — Soft dividers, input borders, ghost button borders, secondary surface tint — cool pale blue-gray that whispers separation without weight

terracotta.$description: Terracotta — Brand accent, feature card fill, decorative blob shape, warm highlight — the most saturated color in the system, used sparingly as energetic punctuation

lavender.$description: Lavender — Brand accent, feature card fill, decorative blob shape, soft highlight wash — dusty pastel violet that softens the palette

plum.$description: Plum — Dark accent surface, deep feature card variant, outlined action border — the saturated dark violet that anchors the lavender to something readable

sky.$description: Sky — Gray action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments

cream.$description: Cream — Soft warm tint, outlined action border, decorative wash — peachy off-white that warms the palette without adding saturation

stabilgrotesk.$description: Single-family type system carrying everything from micro-labels to display headlines. The custom geometric grotesque's tight apertures and compressed letterforms at 700 give the display sizes a hand-cut quality; 400 body weight is unusually readable for a display-origin face. Negative tracking (-0.03em at display, -0.02em at heading) is signature — the headlines feel cut from a single strip. Uppercase labels at 0.1em tracking create quiet eyebrow rhythm.
